events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975, featuring the timeless title track.

angles.name: Imagine Impact
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago today, John Lennon released an album that asked us to imagine a better world. Still as powerful as ever, isn't it?

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Gordon Matthew Sumner, known worldwide as Sting, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Sting's Sound
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Sting! From The Police to his solo career, his distinctive voice and incredible songwriting have given us so many classics.

events.title: First iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we carry and listen to music.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? Twenty-five years ago, Apple dropped a game-changer that put 1,000 songs in your pocket. How many did you fill yours with?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Theme
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! We're celebrating over six decades of 007. What's your favourite Bond theme tune or iconic movie moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're reflecting on the enduring legacy of John Lennon. A true icon of music and peace.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is simply unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album,' on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Influence
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since its release, The Beatles' 'White Album' continues to fascinate. Its eclectic mix of styles proved they could do anything. What's your standout track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Tribute
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the music world lost the incomparable Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we said goodbye to a true rock god. Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain legendary. Forever missed, never forgotten.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Sound
angles.copy: It's been 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that truly marked a shift in their sound. Which track still gives you that classic 60s vibe?

events.title: John Lennon Death Anniversary
events.blurb: We remember John Lennon, who tragically passed away on this day in 1980.

angles.name: Peace and Music
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost a voice of peace and music. John Lennon's message continues to resonate.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the visionary David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's Influence
angles.copy: On what would have been his 80th birthday, we celebrate the boundless artistry and enduring influence of David Bowie. A true chameleon of rock.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Honouring the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 92 today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: The King would have been 92 today! Join us in celebrating the incredible life and music of Elvis Presley. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's iconic sound and one of rock's greatest guitarists.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic British singer Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod's Raspy Voice
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 82nd birthday to Sir Rod Stewart! That unmistakable voice has given us decades of hits. What's your go-to Rod track?
